REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE

  7:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

INVOCATION – REV. JOACHIM ABLANIDA, HOLY FAMILY CATHOLIC CHURCH

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE – RED RIBBON WEEK STUDENTS

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS

Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council should fill out a speaker card and give that
card to the City Clerk at the staff table prior to the commencement of the meeting. Please
observe a time limit of three (3) minutes when giving your presentation.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS THAT ARE NOT ON THE AGENDA OR ITEMS
LISTED UNDER THE HEADING CONSENT CALENDAR

This time is for members of the public to address the Councilmembers on items that are
not listed on the agenda. Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20
minutes will be heard at the end of the meeting. If a member of the public wishes to speak
on a Consent Calendar item, the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar for
separate discussion and to allow the member of the public to speak on the Consent
Calendar item at that time. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the City Council is
prohibited from taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the
matter to staff or to a subsequent meeting.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

This is the time for general comments, announcements, and requests of staff and/or
other issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this time.

CEREMONIAL PRESENTATION

  1. PROCLAMATION OF RED RIBBON WEEK
  STAFF REPORT

  Page 1 of 4
 BUSINESS PRESENTATIONS

  2. ARTESIA LIBRARY UPDATES
  STAFF REPORT

  3. BEAUTIFICATION AND MAINTENANCE COMMISSION UPDATES
  STAFF REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

It is recommended that Items (4) through (13) be acted on simultaneously in one vote
unless a member of the City Council requests separate discussion and/or action on the
item. In the event a member of the City Council requests separate discussion on a
Consent Calendar item, or the item is removed from the Consent Calendar to allow a
member of the public to speak on the item, the City Council will consider that item
immediately following approval of the rest of the Consent Calendar.

  STAFF REPORT

  STAFF REPORT ATTACHMENT

ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS

This time is set-aside for the public to address the City Council on any item of interest
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the City Council that could not be heard under
public comment section at the beginning of the meeting.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

This is the time for additional general comment, announcements, and requests of staff
and/or other issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this
time.

  ADJOURNMENT TO

CITY OF ARTESIA
  ARTESIA CITY HALL, ARTESIA COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE, ARTESIA, CA 90701

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  MONDAY, OCTOBER 14, 2019
  7:00 P.M.

The Regular Meeting of the Artesia City Council was called to order at 7:00 p.m., on Monday,
October 14, 2019 in the Artesia City Council Chambers by Mayor Lima. The Invocation was
presented by Rev. Joachim Ablanida from Holy Family Catholic Church. The Pledge of Allegiance
was led by Red Ribbon Week Students.

 PRESENT:  Melissa Ramoso, Councilmember
  Rene Trevino, Councilmember
  Ali Taj, Councilmember
  Miguel Canales, Mayor Pro Tem
  Tony Lima, Mayor

 ALSO PRESENT:  William Rawlings, City Manager
  Hongdao Nguyen, City Attorney
  Ernesto Sanchez, City Clerk
  Jamie Murguia, Assistance City Clerk
  Melissa Burke, Administrative Manager
  Siamlu Cox, Acting Finance Manager

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  Councilmember Trevino requested that item no. 8 be removed from the agenda.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER TAJ TO APROVE THE AGENDA WITH THE
  EXCEPTION OF ITEM NO. 8.

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR PRO TEM CANALES.

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The Agenda was approved without objections 5-0-0-0.

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS

  City Clerk presented the Announcement Regarding Speaker Cards.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS THAT ARE NOT ON THE AGENDA OR ITEMS LISTED
UNDER THE HEADING CONSENT CALENDAR

  There were no public comments.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Page 1 of 5
   Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Councilmember Trevino provided comments.

  Councilmember Taj provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided comments.

  Mayor Lima provided comments.

CEREMONIAL PRESENTATION

1. PROCLAMATION OF RED RIBBON WEEK

  Mayor Lima presented a Proclamation of Red Ribbon Week to various schools in the
  ABC Unified School District.

  Students and teachers from ABC Unified School District provided comments.

BUSINESS PRESENTATIONS

2. ARTESIA LIBRARY UPDATES

  Robert Gardner, Community Library Manager, presented Artesia Library Updates.

3. BEAUTIFICATION AND MAINTENANCE COMMISSION UPDATE

  Crisalyn Torre, Vice Chair of the Beautification and Maintenance Commission,
  presented Beautification and Maintenance Commission Update.

CONSENT CALENDAR (ITEM NO. 4 - 13)

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales pulled Item No. 12 for discussion.

  Mayor Lima pulled Item Nos. 11 and 13 for discussion.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER TAJ TO APPROVE THE CONSENT CALENDAR
  WITH THE EXCEPTION OF ITEM NOS. 11, 12 AND 13.

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR PRO TEM CANALES.

  Said motion carried (5-0-0-0) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Trevino, Taj, Canales and Lima
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Consent Calendar was approved without objections 5-0-0-0.

  Page 2 of 5
 ITEM NO. 11 WAS PULLED FOR DISCUSSION

  Mayor Lima provided comments and asked questions regarding item.

  City Manager answered questions regarding item.

  MOTION BY MAYOR LIMA TO REFER ITEM NO.11 BACK TO THE PLANNING
  COMMISSION.

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER TAJ.

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Item No. 11 was referred back to the Planning Commission
  without objections 5-0-0-0.

ITEM NO. 12 WAS PULLED FOR DISCUSSION

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales requested a Staff Report on Item No. 12.

  City Manager provided Staff Report.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided comments.

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  MOTION BY MAYOR PRO TEM CANALES TO RECEIVE AND FILE ITEM NO. 12.

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR LIMA.

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Item No. 12 was received and filed without objections 5-0-0-0.
ITEM NO. 13 WAS PULLED FOR DISCUSSION

  Margaret Saito, resident, provided public comments.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER TAJ TO APPROVE ITEM NO. 13.

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR LIMA.

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Item No. 13 was approved without objections 5-0-0-0.

DISCUSSION ITEMS

14. INFORMATIONAL REPORT REGARDING OPTIONAL TAX MEASURES ON A 2020
  BALLOT

  Margaret Saito, resident, provided public comments.

  City Manager provided Staff Report.

  Page 3 of 5
   Councilmember Trevino provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided comments.

  Councilmember Trevino provided additional comments.

  Mayor Lima provided comments.

  Councilmember Taj provided comments.

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Councilmember Trevino provided additional comments.

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The City Council directed Staff to bring additional information
  regarding Item No. 14 at the next City Council Meeting.

15. INFORMATIONAL REPORT ON CONSIDERATION OF CANNABIS BUSINESSES

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided comments.

  Councilmember Taj provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided additional comments.

  Councilmember Trevino provided comments.

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments and asked questions regarding item.

  City Manager answered questions regarding items.

  Mayor Lima provided comments.

  Councilmember Ramoso provided additional comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided additional comments.

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The City Council directed Staff to bring additional information
  regarding Item No. 15 at the next City Council Meeting.

COUNCILMEMBER/STAFF INFORMATIONAL REPORTING

16. COUNCILMEMBER’S REPORTING ON EXTERNAL BOARDS AND COMMITTEE
  MEETINGS ATTENDED

  Councilmember Ramoso reported on the Los Angeles County Vector Control meeting.

  Councilmember Taj reported on an Eco Rapid meeting.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales reported on the League of Cities meeting.

  Page 4 of 5
   Mayor Lima reported on the Gateway Council of Governments meeting and Water Board
  meeting.

17. COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS ON MEETINGS ATTENDED AT PUBLIC EXPENSE

  Councilmember Trevino attended the RTA All-You-Can-Eat Fundraiser.

  Councilmember Ramoso attended RTA All-You-Can-Eat Fundraiser.

  Councilmember Taj attended RTA All-You-Can-Eat Fundraiser.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales attended the RTA All-You-Can-Eat Fundraiser.

  Mayor Lima attended the RTA All-You-Can-Eat Fundraiser.

18. CITY MANAGER INFORMATION BRIEF

  City Manager provided Information Brief.

ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS

  Bob Medina, resident, provided public comments.

  Josie Campbell, resident, provided comments.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Councilmember Trevino provided comments.

  Councilmember Taj provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided comments.

  Mayor Lima provided comments.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Lima adjourned the regular meeting at 9:24 p.m.
